updates.title: Fixes “Supabase cloud SDK could not be loaded” sign-in error
updates.notes: If the bundled Supabase library fails to load on a device (which was blocking sign-in on some phones with 'Supabase cloud SDK: could not be loaded'), the app now automatically fetches it from the internet so you can sign in. Also refreshes the bundled library to the official 2.108.2 build and, if it ever still fails, shows the exact error instead of a generic message. No data or feature changes. Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
